name: Mask Limb
body:
School illusion (phantasm) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 2, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a silk or satin glove)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Will disbelief; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You convince the subject of this spell that they are missing a body part. You must choose one of the following body parts at the time of casting: arm, foot, hand, or leg. If your target fails its Will saving throw, it suffers the appropriate penalties as per the sever combat maneuver for the duration of the spell.
